citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon comforts Chandra, and they recall how they met and the Purifying Fire; Chandra confesses guilt over the Sanctum of Stars and asks for a hug.
quote: He's standing with arms wide, smiling.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa finds Chandra in Gideon's arms, and Chandra awkwardly tries to explain.
quote: Nissa sets a plate of eggplant and potato curry on one of the benches

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon, torn, asks Nissa to keep Chandra safe and returns to the Hub's defenses.
quote: "Keep her safe."

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baral leads Chandra through old stone streets toward a trap.
quote: "All that time your mother suffered . Thinking you were dead ."

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Chandra turns the thorn wall into a fire and injures her arm; Nissa's vines and elemental destroy Baral's thopters.
quote: A trio of vines leapt up from the neighboring streets, raining debris.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baral and Baan escape the failed trap in a thopter, and the Consulate's next phase begins.
quote: High above them, the black specks of thopters lifted from the decks of Skysovereign .

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon is stomped by a Gearhulk, survives, and climbs it to survey the battle.
quote: "It's all right," he called, with forced cheer. "I'm indestructible."

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana rots a living-wood Gearhulk to pieces.
quote: She snapped her fingers, and the Gearhulk fell to pieces at her feet.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon drops into a Gearhulk's gears and wrecks it from inside; Shadowblayde's crew rescues him.
quote: He looked into the gap between the armor, took a few rapid breaths, and dropped into the gears.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon sees Consulate thopters approaching the Hub and rushes back.
quote: "Get back to the Hub!" he shouted, breaking into a run.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baral confronts Chandra and Nissa on a rooftop; Nissa fights his automatons with a sword and Baral nearly kills Chandra with his blade.
quote: The blade falls.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Thopter lightning strikes Mrs. Pashiri on the Hub platform after Baral orders the lifecrafter taken out.
quote: Mrs. Pashiri seizes and topples, smoke-colored braids flying apart.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baral claims he killed Kiran Nalaar and Chandra's auntie and prepares to kill Chandra; Chandra gathers superheated fire, ready to release it.
quote: "I killed your daddy, renegade," he says.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa embraces Chandra and talks her down from detonating, guiding her to put out the fire through a memory of floating in a quarry.
quote: "Don't leave us," Nissa says, softly. "You're loved."

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa's elemental batters Baral, and the women escape.
quote: A tree slammed into him from the left.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baan arrests the injured Baral for murder, attempted murder, extrajudicial incarceration and falsifying records.
quote: Chief Inspector Dhiren Baral, I charge you with one count of murder

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Baan reports the Hub regained and leaves Baral under arrest.
quote: The Aether Hub has been regained.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon carries the wounded Chandra to the Heart of Kiran hanging over Weldfast, where the renegades have retreated.
quote: Heart of Kiran had carried the escapees from the Aether Hub to the safety of Weldfast, solidly renegade territory.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Ajani heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
quote: This was not your fault, Chandra.

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Pia embraces Chandra, telling her she cannot lose her again.
quote: "I can't lose you again."

citation.text: "Burn" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: An aven vizier arrives to repair the barrier and questions their strange clothes; Jace reads his mind and bluffs a cover story about a faraway district.
quote: Well, of course, that's why I'm here in the . . . Nitin district, to teach you.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon decides they should keep their other-planar origin hidden despite Chandra's wish to open the people's eyes.
quote: We shouldn't draw attention to ourselves any more than we need to

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana charms Temmet by claiming they were on a mission for the Horned One, and the group learns the standard greeting.
quote: "We have been out in the desert for some time," she said, "on a special mission for the Horned One."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Temmet leads them through the city, where they see people training and the Anointed doing all labor.
quote: "The Anointed perform all the work here, so the living need do nothing but train.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon meets the god Oketra, who names him Kytheon Iora and says the others' fates are undecided.
quote: "You're one of mine, Kytheon Iora," she said.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon recalls Heliod and the death of his Irregulars, doubting he can trust a god again.
quote: The mission Heliod had set before him had led to the death of Gideon's closest friends, his Irregulars.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Temmet lodges them in two rooms; Gideon watches Oketra walk to her temple.
quote: Liliana swept into one of the rooms and closed the door without a word.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: On the balcony Gideon tells Chandra his birth name was Kytheon Iora and explains what gods are and how Oketra differs.
quote: "Kytheon," he said. "Kytheon Iora."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: A woman runs through the street shouting that the trials, gods and hours are lies; soldiers including a minotaur capture her while Gideon restrains Chandra.
quote: "The return will bring only devastation and ruin!"

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Temmet explains the woman was pursued by viziers of Bontu and her crop was due for a trial; the group wonders if the people are being harvested.
quote: "She proved herself unworthy of life among us."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: Unable to sleep, Gideon seeks out Oketra at dawn, telling her he seeks her.
quote: "You," he said.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

summary: In a vision Nissa hears Amonkhet's soul describe its curse and the catacombs from which Bolas took their dead.
quote: I protected the vessels to keep their souls alive and he took. . . them . . .

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa wakes, finds the plane's soul painful to touch, and asks Chandra to search for the shouting woman.
quote: "I'm going to go on a walk to find the woman from yesterday.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa and Chandra walk through Naktamun, noting that everyone is a trainee under twenty and mummies do all the labor.
quote: The enchanted dead were the ones who did all the work.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa, feeling ill, confesses to Chandra that she is learning what friendship means; Chandra says she wants to be a good friend.
quote: "I am thankful for your companionship.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Hapatra introduces herself at Rhonas's Monument and explains that preserved bodies are enchanted to serve the living while they train for the Trials.
quote: We preserve the bodies left behind, and since training for the Trials is our mortal duty, we enchant the vessels to act in service to humanity.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Hapatra reveals the God-Pharaoh's return and the Hours begin when the sun rests between the horns, any day now.
quote: "The Hours will begin when the sun rests between the horns. I'd estimate any day now."

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa and Chandra realize they have two days to find answers and follow Nissa's sense of the woman's energy toward an alley.
quote: felt the tug of the woman's energy through what was left of the leylines.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: The Raven Man appears and chides Liliana for sending shades to search rather than looking herself, and presses her to stay focused on her demon.
quote: One of your demons is in reach, and time is running out.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: The Raven Man reveals that he took command of the Chain Veil to blast Liliana out of the wurm's belly when she arrived on Amonkhet, which she did not know.
quote: Didn't I take command of the Chain Veil to blast you out of that wurm's belly when you arrived here?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana warns the Raven Man to vanish as Jace approaches, and he disappears indignantly.
quote: "Don't forget why you're here," he said, and vanished indignantly.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Jace finds Liliana at her tent and they discuss the strange mummies and ambient necromancy of the city.
quote: it's possible they were raised by some kind of ambient necromancy.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: A shade reports it has found something, and Liliana leads Jace through the city, noticing that all the mummies are maimed.
quote: Have you noticed that all the mummies in the city are maimed?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Hiding in an alcove, Liliana and Jace watch mummies carry the freshly slain bodies of initiates down the corridor.
quote: The mummies carried the bodies of initiates slain in combat, dripping blood, wrapped in rags.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: They follow the mummies into the central chamber and see embalming on an industrial scale, which Liliana judges purely practical rather than religious.
quote: Not a religious rite. Purely practical.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: A corpse stirs before it is wrapped and the mummies silence it by pressing a metal cartouche to its chest.
quote: They pressed the cartouche into place on the body's chest.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: At a mural of the afterlife, Liliana and Jace see Razaketh depicted guarding the gate as the final test.
quote: Beyond the gate, Razaketh. Beyond Razaketh, paradise.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana admits she is hunting Razaketh, and Jace angrily accuses her of breaking the Gatewatch's trust by hiding her demons.
quote: You broke our trust.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: The carving of Razaketh opens its eyes and the mummies whisper Liliana's name, then attack her and Jace.
quote: The carving of Razaketh . . . opened its eyes.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana realizes that an ambient magic raises all the dead on Amonkhet and that the mummies are controlled physically through the cartouches.
quote: There was something on this world—natural or artificial, it hardly mattered—that raised the dead.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana and Jace wrench a cartouche from a mummy, which bursts with white light and falls apart, and the mummies then surround them.
quote: The hole left by the cartouche burned with blinding white light, and the mummy fell apart.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Temmet arrives, commanding the mummies, and reveals he checked the birth records and knows the pair are outsiders.
quote: But I checked the birth records at the Monument of Knowledge,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana says they have met the Horned One, and Temmet has the mummies choke her in rage.
quote: We've met him, actually,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Jace takes control of Temmet's mind, and through him the mummies, then urges Liliana to run.
quote: Jace was controlling Temmet, and Temmet was controlling the mummies

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Liliana decides she needs the others and runs from her demon toward help.
quote: She ran, away from her demon, toward help.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa wanders the beautiful, empty city and uses her mana sense to perceive the dark strain strangling Amonkhet's leylines.
quote: A dark virulent strain wove its way through the leylines.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa opens her eyes to find a statue of Kefnet, whose doors swing open with blue light, and she steps inside.
quote: a pair of large limestone doors swung open.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: A young man in the anteroom tries to probe Nissa's mind, fails, and admits she is not from here.
quote: You . . . you . . . are not from here,

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa is struck by the fear that she herself brings the blight and failure to every plane she visits.
quote: She had failed to protect Zendikar. Failed to overcome Emrakul.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: The young man tells her she may attempt the Trial of Knowledge; Nissa panics, flings him against the wall, and runs into the blue light.
quote: she flung him against the stone walls.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: In the trial Nissa suffers a nightmare of an angel who says she can do anything, a voice she realizes was both Emrakul's and her own.
quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Through a cascade of nightmares, Nissa hears an inner voice telling her to stop, and realizes she is trapped in the trial's illusion.
quote: There had been one nightmare after another, each one cascading into the next.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa studies the leyline structure of the trap, finds a tiny gap with her eyes shut, widens it and steps through.
quote: In the weavings of magic surrounding her, there was a tiny gap.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Seeing through the illusions, Nissa witnesses a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, starting with Amonkhet.
quote: For what I require, I would drain every world.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa sees a vision of eight stars, three of which go dark, leaving a pattern like horns.
quote: Their new outline suggested a pair of horns.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Visions show mummies mining blue ore, three children swallowed by the sands, a line of darkness stretching through thousands of worlds, and a golden sun disc crumbling.
quote: she saw an unbroken line of darkness from Amonkhet all the way back to the beginning of the line.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: The illusory angel appears, asks if Nissa is pawn or queen, and tells her to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.
quote: Stop being a piece, Nissa. Be the hand that moves.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Kefnet appears and furiously demands who mocks his trial.
quote: It was the god himself, Kefnet.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Kefnet plucks Nissa's thoughts and tells her knowledge is earned, offering dissolution as kindness to the unworthy.
quote: Dissolution is my kindness for you.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Kefnet declares she has passed her trial and flies away.
quote: You have passed your trial.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Nissa resolves to stop being a pawn, notes the pattern she left in Kefnet, dispels the illusions, and leaves the temple.
quote: She was tired of being a pawn, constantly reacting to nightmares and failures, never ahead.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

summary: Gideon observes that the gods walk among the people but are not with them.
quote: The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them.

citation.text: Anointed Procession (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: The Gatewatch is surprised to find perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas.
quote: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

citation.text: Open into Wonder (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Gideon watches an initiate murder his crop-mate and his admiration of Naktamun turns to horror.
quote: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

citation.text: Cruel Reality (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Djeru tells Samut they must leave the unworthy behind.
quote: We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut.

citation.text: Baleful Ammit (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Djeru shows a cursed minotaur as a warning of what awaits those who fail.
quote: That is what awaits us if we fail.

citation.text: Cursed Minotaur (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Chandra says she likes Amonkhet less the more she sees.
quote: The more I see of this place, the less I want to.

citation.text: Faith of the Devoted (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Chandra declares dissent is about to break out among the gods.
quote: Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!

citation.text: By Force (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Nissa senses death permeating the plane.
quote: Death has seeped into every part of this plane.

citation.text: Shadow of the Grave (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Liliana finds it easy to command the dead on Amonkhet.
quote: The nature of this plane makes it almost too easy for me to command the dead.

citation.text: Desiccated Naga (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Liliana remains unmoved by the sight of angels.
quote: Angels? My feelings remain unchanged.

citation.text: Seraph of the Suns (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Jace admires the mummy embalmers.
quote: They might be dead, but these mummies are masters of their trade.

citation.text: Embalmer's Tools (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Samut questions what lies beyond the Hekma and the reach of the gods.
quote: Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma?

citation.text: Evolving Wilds (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Samut declares she will no longer fight just for the honor of dying.
quote: I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying.

citation.text: Samut, Voice of Dissent (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Temmet praises a system in which the dead do all the work and the living only train.
quote: The dead perform all the work here

citation.text: Those Who Serve (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Temmet notes that some refuse to appreciate the God-Pharaoh's gifts.
quote: there are those who refuse to appreciate all that the God-Pharaoh provides for us.

citation.text: Time to Reflect (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Ukhat tells initiates to take comfort in the God-Pharaoh's presence.
quote: you can feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh. Take comfort in that.

citation.text: Splendid Agony (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Oketra urges initiates to stand with their crop and become the storm.
quote: Stand with your crop. Become the storm.

citation.text: In Oketra's Name (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Hazoret tells initiates that only one will be honored by her spear.
quote: only one of you will be honored by my spear.

citation.text: Limits of Solidarity (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Rhonas tells initiates they will overcome the trial's dangers or feed them.
quote: You will overcome them, or you will feed them.

citation.text: Crocodile of the Crossing (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Kefnet teaches that a trained mind can explore the impossible.
quote: A trained mind can explore the impossible.

citation.text: Decision Paralysis (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Bontu tells initiates that ambition requires abandoning doubts.
quote: If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned.

citation.text: Unburden (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Acolytes walk along the Hekma, staring at the horrors the God-Pharaoh's barrier keeps at bay.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva sees the false Mevra gliding down the path with feet off the ground and calls her out.
quote: You aren't Mevra. You're no kin of mine.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

quote: A dragon unfolded out of the illusion, so magnificent a creature that the memory of Atarka's might seemed paltry in comparison.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas says he wants Ugin, admits he killed him once before, and tries to enlist Naiva to destroy him for all eternity.
quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas offers Naiva rule of the world if she tells him where Ugin is, and Naiva asks why he hates his twin.
quote: Why do you hate Ugin? He's your twin.

summary: Bolas denies that Ugin is his twin, calling it a story Ugin spread to share his glory.
quote: That's just a story he put about, trying to grab for a share of my glory and my triumph.

quote: Somehow, amazingly, this powerful dragon did not know Ugin's body lay concealed beneath the hedrons.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva challenges Bolas that he was born together with Ugin, and he roars in anger and asks who told her.
quote: Of course that's not right! Who told you that?

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas begins his account, claiming he woke first and woke Ugin, who flew only because he taught him.
quote: In this way he discovered flight or, I should say, I taught him that flight is what we dragons are made for.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva interrupts to say there were eight dragons, and Bolas swats a foreclaw down to knock her over.
quote: Do not interrupt me again!

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas claims he alone dared to land on the ground and named the world Dominaria.
quote: So, I named our home Dominaria, because I claimed its song for myself.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas says a spark of rage ignited him and he became a planeswalker, arriving at a mirror sea.
quote: With my next breath, I comprehended the whole: I had become a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas visits Arcades's kingdom, hears he last saw Ugin long ago, and plants doubts in his mind about his subjects.
quote: I insinuated a worm of doubt in his haughty mind

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas claims he found Ugin floating in the Meditation Realm and that Ugin attacked him, leading to a long struggle across the planes.
quote: He attacked, viciously and without warning, all raw fury and malignant resentment.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas claims he killed Ugin in the Meditation Realm in self-defense, and the shockwaves hurled him back to Dominaria on Madara.
quote: There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

quote: He has plagued me ever since, most recently with a misbegotten plan to trap me on Ixalan by means of a magical artifact.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas preys on Naiva's resentments toward Baishya and offers to make her the great hunter and leader.
quote: You could finally become the great hunter and leader you deserve to be.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

quote: All you need do is bring me Yasova. Now.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva tells Bolas that Yasova is hiding right there.
quote: She's here. Right here. Hiding.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva crawls into the hedron, finds Baishya and Yasova, and presses her knife to Baishya's throat.
quote: Pulling her knife from its sheath, she pressed the blade against Baishya's vulnerable throat.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

quote: "You think they know we're here?"

citation.text: Ever-Watching Threshold (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "Those who seek my protection shall receive it."

citation.text: Nylea's Colossus (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Tawnos says his master believes anything is achievable.
quote: "My master believes anything is achievable."

citation.text: Tawnos, Urza's Apprentice (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "My people have always been here, and here we shall remain."

citation.text: Tuvasa the Sunlit (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: A figure claims Serra lives on through her.
quote: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

citation.text: Serra Avatar (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Blasphemous Act (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Magmaquake (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "When the land is angry, so are they."

citation.text: Rampaging Baloths (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."

citation.text: Utter End (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Hedron Archive (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "I love what they've done with the place."

citation.text: Grim Backwoods (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."

citation.text: Orzhov Guildgate (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: "When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."

citation.text: Temple of the False God (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact.

citation.text: Unwinding Clock (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

quote: Here, he erects two gigantic curved horns so they emerge from the waters

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva and Baishya wake from the memories and tell Yasova what they saw; Yasova decides to surrender herself to Bolas as a desperate gamble.
quote: The Spirit Dragon has not forgotten Tarkir. We have a chance to deflect Bolas.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Yasova has Baishya wear Naiva's mantle and necklace to meet Bolas in Naiva's place.
quote: Baishya will wear your mantle and go out in your place.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Yasova and Baishya face Bolas, taunting him that he came back to confirm Ugin was dead.
quote: You came back to see if he was really dead.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Bolas threatens to devastate Tarkir and orders Naiva to kill Yasova, but Naiva resists in the hedron.
quote: Do it, Naiva. I command you! Kill her, and I will grant you all that you desire

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Naiva emerges to find the dragon gone and discovers Yasova and Baishya alive, shielded by Baishya's earth magic.
quote: A big boulder shifted with a great, grinding rumble.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: The rest of the party arrives; Tae Jin tells Naiva he would never mistake her for her sister again.
quote: I wouldn't mistake you for your sister ever again.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Yasova tells the girls they must safeguard memory and asks Tae Jin to stay to recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
quote: I would like you to recite Ugin's story once again to Fec so it can be carved and preserved in more than one place.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Yasova closes by telling the girls that even the greatest of dragons can die and that anything may come to pass in the unwritten now.
quote: Even the greatest of dragons can die.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

summary: Vivien, aboard Frederic's ship, refuses to stow the Arkbow and expresses concern over the brontodon captive.
quote: There will be medical attention waiting for the brontodon, I hope?

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: At the pier Vivien pins a human pickpocket who offers blood as penance, and Frederic offers her a dirk to take it.
quote: This is the currency of Luneau, mademoiselle.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: Vivien refuses the blood and frees the pickpocket, accusing Luneau of being a glorified abattoir.
quote: I'd say you were bullying this boy into accepting his lot as livestock

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: Frederic claims Luneau preserves species, and Vivien tours the marble city with disgust.
quote: Preservation, mademoiselle. You never know when a species might go extinct.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: Frederic touches Vivien's wrist and asks about her home, and she recalls Skalla's destruction by fire.
quote: She tried not to think of fire.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

quote: For one terrible moment, the Planeswalker could understand Nicol Bolas, the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: In the Perfumed Court, Frederic tells Vivien that the Baron of Vernot believes there are giants among the lizards, and the Arkbow urges Vivien to destroy Luneau, though she decides to wait.
quote: The Arkbow loathed this place.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: King Lucard and Queen Salazar enter and the court bows, but Vivien stays unbowed.
quote: Alone of them, Vivien stood unbowed, chin tipped up.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: The Baron of Vernot, Marcois Jean-Jaquent, enters and calls his special guests.
quote: We are ready for you.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: At the Tourdion, performers torture lizards, bears, raptors and cranes, and Vivien protests.
quote: This is cruelty,

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: The baron presents a new monstrosaur, tortured and with its largest teeth plucked.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

quote: the seething, glimmering green outline of a hydra wrenched itself from the arrowhead and howled its hunger for the world to see.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

summary: The wounded monstrosaur, forgotten amid the chaos, crushes a guard in triumph.
quote: And as it did, it screamed and this time, there was triumph in the noise.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

summary: Leighbet, moonlighting as an analyst, follows the Golgari troll Kel'teth through the Tenth District sewers to find what is making fatbergs immune to electricity.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Kel'teth saves Leighbet from a sewer siren by throwing cement at it.

summary: Leighbet demands a promotion from Master Dax, is fired and loses her access and title, and starts an unsanctioned lab in the boilerpit beneath her apartment.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Leighbet hires Tamsyn Sweene as a blastseeker, who claims past experience and passes a practical test.

summary: Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity.
quote: It's completely impervious to electricity.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Tamsyn tells a false story of her chemister's death and talks Leighbet into hiring her by promising to get the lab approved without sanctions.
quote: I can get your lab declared an Innovative Niche Workshop.

summary: Tamsyn gets the lab officially recognized by the Izmundi and recruits five paid test subjects, and the serum protects all of them from electric shocks.
quote: The other four tests go exactly the same, successes all around.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Tamsyn convinces Leighbet that the test subjects must be silenced and poisons all five with a lethal sleep elixir, and Leighbet goes along with it.
quote: I already gave them all a hyper-concentrated dose of sleep elixir laced with an ethereal death accelerant.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, then flees into the sewers.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Tamsyn attacks Leighbet with electricity and declares the serum a Dimir discovery; an arc drake's electric breath hits them in the water.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

summary: Leighbet builds a makeshift ballast from sewer junk, stuns Tamsyn with a thrown welding jar and redirects her own blast back at her.
quote: When the next blast orb comes, I meet it with my makeshift ballast.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

summary: Edgar Markov wakes, drinks Olivia's blood and is presented as her betrothed; he dismisses Sorin's warnings.

summary: Olivia wakes other Markov ancients for the groom's side, and Sorin's family passes him by without a word.

citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Odric hacks the altar to pieces in rage.
quote: A moment later, he found himself hacking the altar to pieces

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Henrika takes shape, announces that the cathars serve Ormendahl, and the two thralls attack Odric, whom he defeats.
quote: Ormendahl is their angel now.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Odric goads Henrika, deducing she is only an errand girl for a demon, and she calls herself a dealmaker.
quote: "I am a dealmaker," she hissed back at him

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: The priest returns bitten, bearing a devil, and Henrika says he will be first to be anointed into the demon's order.
quote: He will be our first.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Thalia crashes through the roof and kills cathar attackers alongside Odric.
quote: Thalia came down along with her and landed hard

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Twenty Domnathi vampires overrun Odric and Thalia.
quote: Soon they were disarmed, overwhelmed, and held at the mercy of Henrika's minions.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: The priest kills the devil over the pool of tears, and the mixture turns crimson and shows the demon's essence.
quote: tore the creature in two

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Henrika slits the throat of the glamered father and demands that Thalia serve; Thalia refuses.
quote: Henrika slit the throat of the father.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Odric leaps in front of Henrika's sword to save Thalia and is mortally wounded.
quote: He leaped in front of the sword moments before it was to take Thalia's hand

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Henrika bites Odric and turns him into a vampire.
quote: she descended upon him, biting into his neck

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: The Domnathi vampires explode because of the blessed water in Odric's blood; Thalia stabs Henrika, who flees as mist.
quote: "There is blessed water in your blood—?!"

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: The vampiric Odric hurls his sword to behead the priest and break the pool, and the demon Ormendahl sinks back into oblivion.
quote: The blade severed the priest's head and lodged in the bowl of the pool.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Odric finds that, as a vampire, he can still see the moon and feels peace; he and Thalia stand together.
quote: "Yes, I can see it."

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

summary: Olivia welcomes the guests and promises a present for Edgar before the wedding.
quote: I have a little something else planned first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: A cage draped in red descends from the ceiling, and Sorin recalls being forced by his grandfather to drink angel blood.
quote: a familiar scent comes to him—angel blood.

summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

summary: The false priest begins the ceremony, and Olivia speaks vows to Edgar that mock him.
quote: And I promise to grant you the honor of being my husband.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: Sorin uses blood magic to cut his chains and objects to the wedding.
quote: A blade of red-black slices through the chains as easily as any sword.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: Sorin fights through the guards and seizes a gold-encrusted sword to kill Olivia.
quote: Three more fall in quick succession, crushed beneath the weight of the new weapon.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: A flash of light throws off Sorin's cut, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key.
quote: Grasping for the now-falling key, Olivia is furious.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: A witch's spirit bursts from the Moonsilver Key, grows a staff and asks Olivia whether she would stoop so low.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

quote: The invitation wards are crumbling.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

quote: It would be a shame if someone aided them in their search.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

quote: "Give the kid a break."

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

summary: Vytas offers Torens fifty gold coins to investigate a keep making screeching noises, and Torens takes the first half and asks about the boy's rent.
quote: Vytas counted out twenty-five, one by one, and slid them across his desk into a pile.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

summary: In a flashback, twelve-year-old Torens pickpockets gold in Hanweir and his brother Elamon rescues him.
quote: Elamon snatched the coins and tossed them back at the wealthy man.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

summary: Boris guides Torens to the keep, unlocks the iron door with a brass sphere, and locks them inside along with Aleksandar who followed to repay Torens.
quote: He shut and locked the door behind them.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

summary: Aleksandar charges up the stairs toward a scream and is taken by devils in the smoke.
quote: he bolted up the stairs

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

summary: In a flashback to the town watch era, Torens, now twenty-one, flees a contraband deal when Elamon arrests him.
quote: he picked up the stein and whipped its contents into Elamon's face

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

summary: Torens finds the shackled prophet Eruth, who says the devils took the boy to their master.
quote: "The devils took the boy to their master."

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

quote: as if the entire town, all at once, had been gouged out of the earth

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

quote: "Your little toy soldier? Yes, I'm aware."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

summary: Edgar slams Sorin into a vat and he relives being forced to drink angel's blood at the family gathering.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

summary: Edgar throws Sorin into a great pit.
quote: And Sorin Markov continues to fall.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

summary: Arlinn chases Olivia through the portrait-lined corridors and corners her in a dead end, where she claws her.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

summary: Arlinn changes into her wolf form and fights Olivia, hurling her through a statue.
quote: Senses sharpen. Strength returns to her as she grows

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

summary: Donal sees a flicker of Avacyn's grace in every wingbeat.
quote: He sees a flicker of Avacyn's grace in every wingbeat.

citation.text: Donal, Herald of Wings (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: The Moormanor library continues to attract visitors after the Travails.
quote: The library of Moormanor had been open to all before the Travails, and it continues to attract curious visitors.

citation.text: Haunted Library (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Olivia orders uninvited wedding crashers disposed of.
quote: These worthless cattle think they can sneak unnoticed into my wedding? Dispose of them.

citation.text: Olivia's Wrath (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Squire Imalia says the mighty had it coming after saving Thiswick.
quote: They had it coming.

citation.text: Fell the Mighty (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: The Angel of Flight Alabaster endures without Avacyn and secretly asks souls whether they have seen her.
quote: She endures without Avacyn but secretly asks each soul she guides if they have seen her.

citation.text: Angel of Flight Alabaster (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Akroma praises a muse's voice as justice.
quote: Her voice is justice, clear and relentless.

citation.text: Windborn Muse (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Oona's song calls all faeries home so she can feast on their stolen dreams and rumors.
quote: All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

citation.text: Distant Melody (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Mu Yanling says she wept a torrent to scour the land clean.
quote: I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean.

citation.text: Flood of Tears (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Toshiro Umezawa compares a masterless kami to himself.
quote: He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick.

citation.text: Kami of the Crescent Moon (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

quote: The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything.

citation.text: Reconnaissance Mission (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Admiral Beckett Brass notes ships on mean seas pick up ghosts.
quote: Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two.

citation.text: Spectral Sailor (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Barvisa declares there is only truth in the Verity Circle.
quote: Here, there is only truth.

citation.text: Verity Circle (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Anowon scorns Chandra Nalaar for holding the map many died seeking.
quote: So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar.

citation.text: Anowon, the Ruin Sage (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Siara describes Silumgar's mind as a dark labyrinth.
quote: Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps.

citation.text: Damnable Pact (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Jarad is mocked as king of rot.
quote: Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot.

citation.text: Necropolis Regent (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Vraska boasts of having seen things that would unhinge weaker people.
quote: I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?

citation.text: Night's Whisper (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Runo Stromkirk orders his followers to slay all who trespass.
quote: No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass.

citation.text: Stromkirk Captain (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: The Sanctum Seekers were the first knightly order to cross the sea.
quote: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

citation.text: Sanctum Seeker (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Dovin Baan mandates lockets to track Senate personnel.
quote: Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency.

citation.text: Azorius Locket (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: The Magic Mirror crystallizes a drop of water into much more.
quote: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

citation.text: Arcane Signet (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Kenjek counsels being prepared before rushing into combat.
quote: There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared.

citation.text: Swiftfoot Boots (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Kiora remarks that people worship whoever answers when gods are apathetic.
quote: When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas.

citation.text: Temple of the False God (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: A haunted fog, the Nebelgast, shrouds Nephalia's coastal cities.
quote: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

citation.text: Port Town (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in shadowy chasms.
quote: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

citation.text: Shadowblood Ridge (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Olivia orders that wedding guests need red envelopes to pass the Lurenbraum barrier, with no exceptions.
quote: Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

citation.text: By Invitation Only (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: While Olivia is distracted, Sigarda tears free from her bindings and summons her Host of Herons.
quote: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

citation.text: Sigarda's Summons (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Thalia vows not to rest until Thraben is cleansed.
quote: I will not rest until it is cleansed.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Vampires of every bloodline gather at the wedding, the event of the century.
quote: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together

citation.text: Wedding Festivity (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Geralf shows his sister a horror inspired by her own face.
quote: Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own.

citation.text: Geralf, Visionary Stitcher (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Ludevic notes in his laboratory notes that Geralf can now replicate his creations with near-perfect accuracy.
quote: Geralf's prowess continues to grow.

citation.text: Necroduality (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: York sees crows in Kessig and nervously insists they are not an omen.
quote: No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder . . . I think.

citation.text: Winged Portent (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Ormendahl tells a human that power has a price and refuses to negotiate.
quote: Do not try to negotiate with me, human.

citation.text: Demonic Bargain (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake is more blood than water.
quote: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake was more blood than water.

citation.text: Dreadfeast Demon (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: Olivia Voldaren explains she prefers waitstaff with their bodies attached.
quote: I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached.

citation.text: Dying to Serve (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary: The Headless Rider wanders the Moorlands seeking a worthy head.
